intent: A burnt Ashfields court gown: an ash bodice and a widening ash underskirt under charred overpanels whose bold bone staves fan into a bell, with violet light at the centre seam and the hem, reading from the high camera as a slim ash top over a wide splayed skirt under a bone crown.
requests: A tapered skirt panel or cone: boxes only tilt in straight planes, so the bell is a set of splayed panels rather than one smooth flare.
A ring (torus) for a bone crown/halo: the part set has only boxes, wedges, cylinders and balls, so the crown is separate shards.
